ru_RU.title: NewsBreak: Local News & Alerts
ru_RU.description:
A trusted source of news and information for more than a decade, NewsBreak is where over 40 million Americans a month come to understand what’s happening in their neighborhood. Wherever you live, your daily decisions are shaped by the stories happening close to home – a rain storm, a restaurant recommendation, a road closure, a gas price discount. NewsBreak makes sure you never miss these stories, or the national and international headlines, sports scores, and business updates that matter too.

See only what matters to you
- Set your zip code to personalize your feed
- Follow the topics you care about – and block the ones you don’t
- Subscribe to a customized newsletter: 40+ choices, spanning local news, national coverage, and topics like autos, beauty, cooking, fitness, gardening, health, investment, pets, space, and travel; 3-7 days/week

Always be among the first to know
- See crime activity, mapped to your neighborhood, as it happens
- Compare gas prices at stations near you
- Real-time alerts for weather, traffic, jobs, news, and more

Connect with your community
- Discover local events, businesses, and deals near you
- Focus your job search on your neighborhood
- Watch local video coverage as stories develop
- See and share user-generated posts about your neighborhood
- Share your views on stories and engage with others in accordance with community guidelines for safety, accountability, and accuracy

One place for trusted information
- Trusted local newsrooms from across the nation
- Independent reporters, selected via an application-based program
- National and world news from major outlets: USA Today, CNN, Forbes, NBC News, Fox News, etc.
- Community resources from established sources
- Strictly enforced publisher and contributor standards
ru_RU.shortDescription: Ваш район, ваши предпочтения: события, погода, цены на бензин, карта преступности и оповещения.
